name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
October 9, 2007
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Minister Tom Furrh, Vista Church of Christ
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring October 13, 2007, "Vistans R.O.C. Day" in the City of Vista. (CC)
P2.
Certificate of appointment to incoming Parks and Recreation Commissioner. (CC)
P3.
Proclamation declaring October 19, 20, and 21, 2007, "Knights of Columbus Tootsie Roll Drive Days" in the City of Vista. (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC)
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C4.
Amendment to Agreement with Joe Wall Tractor Service (CC)
C5.
Fiscal Year 2007 Assistance to Firefighters Grant Award (CC)
C6.
First Amendment to the Vista City Maintenance Association 2007-2009 Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) (CC)
C7.
Brownfields Assessment and Cleanup Grants (CC)
C8.
U.S. Soccer Foundation Grant Application (CC)
C9.
Application for Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) License for Jose's Taco, 2440 S. Melrose Drive, Suite 103 (CC)
C10.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending August 31, 2007 (CC)
C11.
Appointments to Commissions/Committees/Boards (CC)
1.
Confirm the Mayor's appointment of Gerald Wroe to the Traffic Commission to fill an unscheduled vacancy for a term ending June 30, 2009;
2.
Confirm the Mayor's appointment of Jose Estrada to the Mobilehome Park Review Board to fill an unscheduled vacancy for a term ending June 30, 2010;
3.
Waive the residency requirement for one student by a three-fifths majority vote in accordance with Vista Municipal Code Section 2.18.060B1; and
4.
Confirm the Mayor's appointments to the Youth Commission and youth representatives on city commissions and committees as listed on the Exhibit 2.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Short Term Improvements for the Vista Skate and Bike Park (CC)
1.
Discuss possible improvements and provide direction to staff; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , amending the FY 2007-2008 Operating Budget.
D2.
Operating Budget for FY 2007-2008 and FY 2008-2009 (CC/CDC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2007- ;
2.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2007- ; and
3.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2007- .
D3.
Capital Improvement Program Budget for FY 2007-2008 and FY 2008-2009 (CC/CDC/BSD)
1.
Adopt the following resolutions transferring unused appropriations for certain capital improvement project accounts to fund balance or retained earnings:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2007- ;
b.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2007- ; and
c.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2007-.
2.
Adopt the following resolutions approving the 2007/08 through 2011/12 Capital Improvement Plan Budgets:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2007- , (excluding S. Santa Fe #8001);
b.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2007- ; (excluding S. Santa Fe #8001); and
c.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2007-.
D4.
Capital Improvement Plan Budget for S. Santa Fe Area Improvements Project for FY 2007-2008 through FY 2011-2012 (CDC)
D5.
2007 Community Projects (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving Mitigated Negative Declarations under CEQA for the 2007 Community Projects; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving the 2007 Community Projects.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
San Clemente Avenue Reimbursement District (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving the establishment of a reimbursement district for San Clemente Avenue improvements and related agreements and appropriating funds for reimbursement for utility undergrounding; and
2.
Direct the City Clerk to record the Resolution establishing the Reimbursement District and Exhibits "A" through "F".
PH2.
Calvary Chapel Church and School (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2007- , certifying the Final Environmental Impact Report prepared for Calvary Chapel Church and School, adopting the Environmental Findings pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act, adopting a Statement of Overriding Considerations, and adopting a Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving a Special Use Permit, Site Development Plan, and Tentative Parcel Map for a church and private school facility exceeding the 35 foot height limit, recreational fields, parking, and a separate industrial building on a 20.9 acre site at 1401 N. Melrose Drive.
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies
ADJOURNMENT
